Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in Selling Module Loyalty Program

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Loyalty Program terms without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other customers' Loyalty Program terms.
Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Accounts Payment Term Settings

Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Term settings without checking whether the caller may read the specific records requested. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read Payment Term settings.
Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Payment Terms Templates

Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Terms Template rows without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read Payment Terms Template data.
Frappe ERPNext 4.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Accounts Module Taxes Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 4.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the taxes and charges of documents without checking record permissions. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no roles, can request arbitrary document types and records to read tax rows beyond their permitted scope.
ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in Bank Statement Import Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns uploaded bank statement file content without checking record-level permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read full statement file contents.
Frappe ERPNext 15.55.0 before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in Accounts Module Chart of Accounts

Frappe ERPNext 15.55.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns a company's Chart of Accounts without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read any company's Chart of Accounts.
Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in Selling Loyalty Points Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns customer loyalty point balances without checking the caller's permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read other customers' loyalty point balances.
Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Taxes and Charges Templates

Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that allows authenticated users to read Taxes and Charges Template rows without permission checks. Attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read account heads and tax rates.
Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in POS Profile Cashiers Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read POS Profile cashier lists by calling a POS endpoint lacking record permission checks. Attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope POS Profiles to retrieve their cashier data.
Frappe ERPNext 8.0.0 before 15.123.0 Missing Authorization in Stock Module Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 8.0.0 before 15.123.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that allows authenticated users to read restricted warehouse data. Attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming warehouses excluded by their User Permissions to obtain stock quantities and stock values.
Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in Regional Module E-Invoice Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Regional module endpoint that returns private e-invoice files after checking only document-type permissions, not per-record User Permissions. Authenticated attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' private e-invoice files.
Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Stock Serial No and Batch Ledger

Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns Serial No and Batch ledger entries without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to obtain item codes, quantities, warehouses, batch and serial numbers.
Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Projects Activity Cost Rates

Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Projects module endpoint that returns employee costing and billing rates without record-level permission checks. Authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other employees' activity cost rates.
Frappe ERPNext 16.0.1 before 16.50.0 Missing Authorization in Stock Dashboard Chart

Frappe ERPNext 16.0.1 before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock dashboard chart endpoint that returns site-wide stock value when the caller has no permitted warehouse. Authenticated users with common operational roles can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read stock value data beyond their permissions.
Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.124.0 Unauthorized Issue Access via Customer Portal

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an authorization flaw in the customer portal Issue list, which scopes records differently from the detail view and skips permission checks on requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other customers' Issues.
ERPNext 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 Unauthorized Supplier Portal Record Access via Party Name Collision

Frappe ERPNext 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a supplier portal endpoint whose party identity check ignores party type, failing to distinguish a Customer and a Supplier that share a name. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read buying-portal records.
Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Accounts Bank Transactions Endpoint

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Bank Transaction metadata of other companies without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to retrieve that metadata.
Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.124.0 Missing Authorization in Customer and Supplier Portals

Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer and supplier portal list endpoint, which returns complete selling documents and RFQs without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can request out-of-scope records to read valuation, margin, and other bidder details.
Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 Unauthorized Project Costing Access via Customer Portal

Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer portal Projects list, which returns every field without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read project costing and margin data.
Frappe ERPNext 13.49.0 before 14.0.0 and 14.17.2 before 15.124.0 Missing Authorization in Selling Module Sales Order Items

Frappe ERPNext 13.49.0 before 14.0.0, 14.17.2 before 15.124.0, and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Sales Order line items without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope Sales Orders to read their line item data.
Frappe ERPNext 8.11.1 before 15.124.0 Unauthorized Document Access via Print and Portal Views

Frappe ERPNext 8.11.1 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 is missing an authorization check in print and portal views, which fail to apply desk users' User Permissions to customer documents. Authenticated desk users with an ordinary job role can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read documents of customers their User Permissions exclude.
Frappe ERPNext 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 Missing Authorization in Period Closing Voucher Status

Frappe ERPNext 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that changes Period Closing Voucher job status without permission checks and accepts a request method triggerable cross-site. Authenticated users without an Accounts role, or cross-site pages opened by authenticated users, can send requests naming a scheduled job to stop accounting jobs from completing.
Frappe ERPNext 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Stock Module Record Creation

Frappe ERPNext 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that checks whether an inventory number exists and creates missing Serial No and Batch master records without verifying create permission. Authenticated users can send a crafted request with a new number to create these records outside their role, affecting inventory data integrity.
Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 Missing Authorization in Bank Reconciliation

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that reconciles Bank Transactions against caller-named vouchers, checking permission only on the Bank Transaction and not on each voucher. Authenticated users with the Accounts User role who can edit a Bank Transaction can send crafted requests naming vouchers outside their permitted scope to change the reconciliation state of vouchers belonging to other companies or outside their User Permissions.
